content.text: Platforms built around a single banking partner have become a clear trend in the UK market, since tying rewards to one payment route lets an operator pay out faster and lift limits. To show where we stand, we set our service against another bank-linked operator and one of the sector's leaders.

rows: **Banking partner and priority**
Withdrawals in 1 hours, up to £30,000 per transaction, separate chat queue
Withdrawals in roughly 30 minutes, priority handling on every transaction

£10 no-deposit (x50 wagering) plus 5 deposit matches from 50% to 300%
Three-deposit package: 100% / 50% / 25% up to £200 each, plus 100 free spins each (up to £600 and 300 spins)
**Bank-partner bonus**
25% reload up to £200 on every Priority deposit (x35 wagering)
+25% on the first deposit over the standard match (125% total, x35 on the extra part)
